fields.longtitle: About Lbar semi-permanent makeup studio by Ksenia Kobilianskaia
fields.description: Detailed information about LBar micropigmentation studio by Ksenia Kobilianskaia in Bucharest (Romania). Our history and our journey

tvs.description-banner-inerial:
LBar micropigmentation studio is a chain of luxury studios with thousands of reviews and recommendations. Over more than 5 years of continuous work, we have become one of the most highly rated and popular cosmetic tattoo studios in Kyiv and Ukraine, and every day, with every procedure we perform, we work hard to live up to that reputation.

Our permanent makeup studio successfully provides its services in Warsaw and Bucharest, while continuing to operate in Kyiv. Over this time, our artists have performed 10,000+ micropigmentation procedures in a variety of techniques and on different areas. We keep improving, providing every procedure with premium supplies, strictly following sanitary standards and carefully looking after the safety of both client and artist.
Today, our permanent makeup studios are spacious, modern and comfortable. Our studio offers a wide range of micropigmentation services, old tattoo removal and professional training courses. The Lbar Tattoo School has trained more than 400 successful artists who now work all over the world.
We work for you, for your beauty and self-confidence. We promise it will be gorgeous!
